heading: 'VIBE' box office collection day 2: Kunal Khemu and Preity Zinta's film records 55.9% growth; earns Rs 2.65 cr on Saturday
author: etimes.in /  Sep 20, 2026, 07:12 IST
paragraphs: Kunal Khemu's 'VIBE' recorded an increase in its box office earnings on Saturday, September 19
The action thriller comedy earned Rs 2.65 cr in India net on Day 2, according to Sacnilk
The movie was screened across 2,979 shows on its first Saturday
The latest collection marks a 55.9% rise over the Rs 1.70 cr earned on its opening day. 'VIBE' registered 14% overall occupancy across 3,194 shows on Friday
Its occupancy increased to 21% on Saturday.'VIBE' earns Rs 2.65 cr on Day 2The second-day earnings have taken 'VIBE' to a total India net collection of Rs 4.35 cr
Its India gross collection currently stands at Rs 5.22 cr
The movie recorded Rs 1.70 cr on Day 1 before adding Rs 2.65 cr on Saturday
Its show count stood at 3,194 on Friday and 2,979 on Saturday.The increase in collections came alongside a rise in audience occupancy
The film's overall occupancy moved from 14% on its opening day to 21% on Day 2.Saturday occupancy reaches 21.92%The Hindi 2D version of 'VIBE' recorded 21.92% overall occupancy on Saturday
Night screenings recorded the highest occupancy at 32.69%.The movie had 3,194 shows on Day 1, with overall occupancy at 14%
On Day 2, the show count was 2,979 and occupancy reached 21%.Kunal Khemu returns as writer-directorKunal Khemu has written, produced and directed 'VIBE'
He also stars in the movie alongside Preity Zinta, Sparsh Shrivastava and Vanshika Dhir
The film marks Kunal Khemu's second directorial venture after 'Madgaon Express', which was released in 2024
It also marks his debut as a producer.The project comes after more than three decades of Kunal Khemu's acting career
He previously took on writing and directing duties with 'Madgaon Express'
Vanshika Dhir makes her acting debut with 'VIBE'
She appears alongside Kunal Khemu, Preity Zinta and Sparsh Shrivastava.'VIBE' follows two friendsThe story of 'VIBE' revolves around two inseparable friends
Their otherwise ordinary lives take an unexpected turn and lead them into a fast-paced adventure
The two characters are forced to rely on their survival instincts as their situation becomes increasingly unpredictable
Their friendship is also tested as they face the challenges that come with their unusual journey
The movie combines action, comedy and thriller elements.ETimes rates 'VIBE' 3.5 starsETimes gave 'VIBE' 3.5 stars out of 5
The review reads, "Vibe is one of those films where the screenplay and sheer entertainment quotient elevate a fairly basic premise
The banter and comic set pieces are top-notch in the first half

The tonality shifts after the interval as the action takes over.The narrative becomes more convoluted and loses momentum in places as it packs in the terrorist plot, spy antics and increasingly outlandish twists
There are familiar tropes, too, including the Sipahi 1 pill that transforms Hardik into a fierce soldier and a surprise entry that saves the day during the climactic fight
Yet, despite these contrivances, the movie remains breezy and engaging enough to keep you invested
Hardik and Bugs’s training to become spies, in particular, makes for a hilarious track."DISCLAIMER: The box office numbers and the data in this article are compiled from public and industry sources
